name: Chrome Scripts
tagline: Adds extra tools to any web page you open, through bookmarks you click in your browser.
summary: A public collection of browser tools that work as bookmarklets: bookmarks that run a tool on the page you are viewing. Each bookmarklet loads the latest copy of its tool from this repository.
features: Turn SiteGround's hosting statistics into a clearer dashboard with charts, reports and exports.
List every image on a page, then search by file name, description or stock photo number.
Open stock photos on iStock, or download the images you select.
Install a tool once as a bookmark that always loads its latest copy.
